The Administrative Assistant to the Marshal/Events Services Coordinator is a principal support services specialist for the Marshal's Office in the Supreme Court of the United States.

The incumbent has principal responsibility for event management, provides administrative support for oral argument sessions and a variety of other support activities and programs.

Works directly with high-level officials, outside vendors and contractors; responsible for researching, designing, planning, coordinating, and evaluating all events and programs under the direction of the Staff Assistant/Event Services Manager.

Must be present for all assigned events (approximately 900 yearly) that occur in the Supreme Court, including after-hour events (approximately 50 yearly).

Constantly faced with changing workloads, short deadlines and unanticipated requirements; logistical planning factors include room setup, rental equipment, audiovisual support, security, media, florists, transportation, entertainment, décor, and effectively integrating internal support staff and outside vendors.

Assists with menu selections, initiates requests for proposals and negotiates catering contracts; assigns the duties of the Supreme Court Police, Building Support Services, Architect of the Capitol staff, and Purveyor staff in connection with each event and maintains financial records.

Acts as the official Courtroom Timekeeper during oral argument; operates Teleconference Bridge for remote participants; works with IT to troubleshoot equipment.

Responsible for receiving visitors, responding to and following through on telephone calls and emails, preparing and distributing correspondence and responsible for completing various assigned projects in a timely manner. Performs other duties as assigned by the Marshal.
Five years of experience with event management and support services procedures are required.

A working knowledge of the Marshal's Office and the various offices of the Supreme Court, the Federal Judiciary and the Federal Government is desired; skill in gathering data and applying sound analyses; superior communications skills, both oral and written; sound judgment, tact, a very courteous demeanor and the ability to interact effectively with high-ranking officials and the general public are required; initiative and the ability to work independently within a team environment are also required.

As an ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT, GS-0303-7, you will: Maintains the appointment schedule for the HRO and the DHRO. Schedules appointments and meetings, independently, based upon personal knowledge of their workload and current issues of importance.

Advises the HRO and the DHRO of scheduled appointments and furnishes information from files or schedules briefings by others in preparation for scheduled meetings. Reschedules appointments when it is apparent that they cannot meet previous schedules. Attends meetings when required to maintain notes. Prepares required slides for meetings.

Receives visitors and telephone calls for the HRO. Assists in the development of policy letters. Coordinates draft policy with other staff directorates prior to submission for final review and approval.

Maintains personal contact with HRO employees, functional managers (Army and Air), NGB personnel, and State personnel to discuss administrative requirements and services. Provides technical advice and guidance and recommends methods and procedures where necessary.

Advises other administrative personnel of latest HRO directives regarding administrative procedures. Reviews incoming correspondence, publications, regulations, and directives.

Prepares and/or reviews outgoing correspondence from the office of the HRO or subordinate branches for grammar, construction, proper format, attachments, continuity of text, policy and procedural adherence, and compliance with the HRO viewpoint. Advises the originator of any discrepancies and provides necessary training.

Maintains office files of correspondence, directives, regulations, and other information. Maintains security of all keys and maintains appropriate records of keys issued to personnel. Performs duties as HRO Publications Officer.

Coordinates with both Army and Air Force publications sources to accomplish ordering, locating electronic publications, updating, and maintaining a current and complete publications library for the HRO. Submits work orders for repairs and maintenance on HRO office equipment and facilities. Performs other duties as assigned.
General Experience: Administrative or clerical experience, education, or training which demonstrates the candidate's ability to perform the duties of the position. Experience using computer and automation systems. Specialized Experience: Must have at least 12 months experience in the interpretation and application of regulations, procedures or laws.

Experience that provided a working knowledge of administrative functions. Experience demonstrating the ability to advise lower graded employees. Experience working independently and setting priorities with very little supervisory control.

This position is in the Supreme Court of the United States, Police Force Administrative Services Unit. The Executive Assistant for the Police Force reports to and receives general direction and supervision from the Administrative Services Unit, Administrative Officer.

However, the individual will directly support the Chief of Police, Deputy Chief of Police, and other Police Leadership staff as designated by the Chief of Police or their designee. The incumbent regularly works with Police leadership to draft written materials and perform a variety of special and complex assignments on behalf of the Chief of Police.

The Executive Assistant's core responsibilities include assisting the Police Executive Team (e.g., Chief of Police, Deputy Chief of Police, and Captains) with compiling reports, responding to inquiries, reconciling and tracking information, and drafting and managing correspondence.

Other major duties include: project management, budget tracking and contracting responsibilities; managing office administration including calendars, schedules, meetings, and travel; research on specialized topics; assisting with other program areas within the department; and providing back-up support with clearance requests, badging and fingerprinting.

At times, the incumbent may be responsible for driving executives, documents, supplies, or equipment to and from events. The incumbent may perform other duties as assigned.
A minimum of four years of office experience is required. Experience working successfully under pressure in a busy office is preferred. Outstanding attention to detail, strong organizational skills, tact, and a courteous demeanor are required. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word is required.

Experience working in a police force, security, or judicial environment is preferable, but not required. Valid driver's license is required. Knowledge and Skills: Strong organizational, communication, and administrative skills, along with proficiency in office software, and the ability to handle complex information.

Key knowledge areas include departmental policies and procedures, federal contract management, booking travel, and records management. Crucial skills involve multitasking, independent judgment, maintaining confidentiality and positive interpersonal interactions with diverse individuals.

Considerable skill in: Following complex and varied oral and written instructions. Establishing and maintaining effective work relationships with associates and the public. Operation of office and computer equipment, including working knowledge of databases, spreadsheets, and word processing software.

Understanding and interpreting policies, directions, and procedures applicable to the Supreme Court, Marshal's Office, and Police Force. Must be able and willing to drive a motor vehicle with passengers to work events.

Description de l'entreprise
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction de l'immobilier (DI) a pour mission de garantir la mise à disposition, l'exploitation et l'évolution des infrastructures hospitalières en cohérence avec les besoins institutionnels et les orientations stratégiques des HUG. Elle veille à une utilisation efficiente des espaces, à l'accompagnement des transformations organisationnelles et à l'amélioration continue des conditions de travail des collaborateurs et collaboratrices.
Le poste est rattaché au service régie immobilière et gestion des affectations (Riga).
Description du poste
En qualité de coordinateur ou coordinatrice gestion des locaux, vous assurez la coordination des demandes liées à l'attribution des locaux, aux aménagements des espaces de travail ainsi qu'aux déménagements des activités et des collaborateurs et collaboratrices au sein des HUG.
Interlocuteur ou interlocutrice privilégiée du personnel, vous analysez les besoins exprimés et veillez à leur cohérence avec la stratégie immobilière institutionnelle ainsi qu'avec le schéma directeur des HUG.
Vous évaluez les demandes, proposez des solutions adaptées et recherchez des alternatives permettant une utilisation efficiente des surfaces et des ressources mises à disposition.
Vous pilotez de manière autonome les mandats d'aménagement et de déménagement de faible à moyenne complexité, depuis leur planification jusqu'à leur réalisation. À ce titre, vous coordonnez les différents intervenants et intervenantes internes et externes, assurez le suivi des prestataires et veillez au respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences réglementaires.
Vous participez activement à l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes concernées par les mouvements d'activités ou les réorganisations d'espaces.
Vous assurez également la gestion et la mise à jour de la signalétique de proximité en collaboration avec la Direction de la communication, tout en veillant au respect de la charte graphique institutionnelle.
Enfin, vous contribuez au maintien et à la fiabilité des inventaires graphiques et alphanumériques des locaux ainsi qu'à la qualité des données de gestion immobilière.

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor en gestion ou administration publique, d-un diplôme de santé ou d'un domaine jugé équivalent.
Vous bénéficiez idéalement d'une expérience confirmée dans la coordination de projets d'aménagement, de déménagement ou de gestion des espaces de travail au sein d'environnements complexes.
Vous possédez des connaissances des normes et réglementations applicables aux espaces de travail, notamment en matière d'ergonomie, de sécurité et d'aménagement des locaux.
Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques usuels. Une expérience sur des logiciels de dessin ou de gestion des espaces constitue un atout.
Vous avez un excellent sens du service, vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'organisation dans la conduite de vos activités.
Votre aisance relationnelle, votre capacité à coordonner et votre aptitude à accompagner le changement vous permettent d'évoluer efficacement dans un environnement hospitalier en constante évolution.
Vous avez d-excellentes capacités d'analyse, êtes pragmatique et proposez des solutions adaptées aux besoins du personnel tout en tenant compte des contraintes institutionnelles.

Die Endress+Hauser Flowtec AG in Reinach entwickelt und produziert weltweit eingesetzte Durchflussmessgeräte und ist ein zentraler Produktionsstandort innerhalb der Endress+Hauser Gruppe.
**Worum geht es in der Stelle?**
Macht es Ihnen Freude, täglich mit Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Inspektorinnen und Inspektoren aus aller Welt zusammenzuarbeiten?
Behalten Sie auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Termine, Aufträge und Anforderungen gleichzeitig koordiniert werden müssen?

Dann erwartet Sie eine vielseitige Schnittstellenfunktion im Produktionsumfeld, in der Sie gemeinsam mit Kunden, Sales Centers sowie Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Produktion, Logistik, Qualitätssicherung und Technik für eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Kundenabnahmen sorgen. Die Position ist bei der Endress+Hauser Flowtec AG angesiedelt und verbindet Kundenkontakt mit Projektkoordination und administrativer Verantwortung.
**Welche Aufgaben werden Sie übernehmen?**

* Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) in Abstimmung mit Kunden, Sales Centers und internen Fachbereichen terminieren, vorbereiten und koordinieren.

* FAT-relevante Dokumente, Prüfberichte und Nachweise erstellen, pflegen und nachverfolgen.
* Abläufe rund um Kundeninspektionen koordinieren und aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kundenerfahrung beitragen.
**Was erwarten wir von Ihnen?**

* Bringen eine hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie einen empathischen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern mit.
* Haben idealerweise Erfahrung in einem industriellen oder produzierenden Umfeld gesammelt.
* Steuern mehrere Aufgaben und Termine gleichzeitig und setzen Prioritäten auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld zuverlässig.
* Kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.
* Nutzen Microsoft 365 routiniert und arbeiten strukturiert sowie sorgfältig mit digitalen Werkzeugen.

* Wir sind ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit großem Engagement und einer nachhaltigen Vision.
* Wir fördern lebenslanges Lernen durch vielfältige Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, internen Wissenstransfer und E-Learning.
* Wir bieten Ihnen eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit direktem Kontakt zu internationalen Kundinnen, Kunden und Inspektoren.
* Wir arbeiten in einem kollegialen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer wertschätzenden Unternehmenskultur.
* Wir stellen sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden in modernen Arbeitsumgebungen mit zeitgemäßer Infrastruktur tätig sind.
* Wir bieten attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen sowie die Möglichkeit, aktiv zum Erfolg eines weltweit führenden Unternehmens beizutragen.

Um sich zu bewerben, bitten wir Sie, Ihre Unterlagen auf unserer Karriereseite hochzuladen.

We are looking for a motivated, highly-organized and detail-oriented (Senior) Executive Assistant to support one of our two Co-CROs. The role can be full or part-time in our Heidelberg HQ, perfect for an experienced EA looking for a change or returning to the workforce.
You will work as part of the CRO Office within a collaborative support team, ensuring the Co-CRO’s day-to-day operations run smoothly. While you will have guidance from the broader team, we value someone who is eager to take ownership of their tasks and who brings a proactive and flexible "can-do" attitude to every challenge.

Calendar Coordination: Manage a busy calendar, scheduling meetings, and ensuring the Co-CRO is well-prepared for their daily appointments.
Inbox Management: Support with organization and prioritization of incoming e-mails.
Travel Arrangements: Organize domestic and international travel, including booking flights, hotels, and local transport, and preparing clear itineraries.
Expense Handling: Organize and submit monthly expense reports accurately and on time.
Meeting Support: Help collect and prepare meeting materials and presentations. Track action items and remind the team of upcoming deadlines.
Project Management: Step in on behalf of the CRO and run contained internal-facing projects across various topic areas such as P&C, striving to define sustainable processes where possible.
Team Support : Provide organizational expertise to the broader Research organization for team meetings, special events, offsites, and the like.

Language Skills: Professional working proficiency in both German and English
Reliability & Detail: You are someone who catches the "small things" and takes pride in delivering high-quality and accurate work.
Proactive Mindset: You don't wait to be told what to do; you look for ways to be helpful and enjoy solving problems independently.
Discretion: You understand the importance of confidentiality and handle sensitive information with the utmost integrity.
Tech Savvy: Comfortable using the Google Suite, Slack and Jira and quick to learn new digital tools.
Quick-Thinking & Adaptable: You stay calm when plans change and pivot between different tasks quickly and easily.

## **Job Description** ##
At Takeda, the Data, Digital & Technology (DD&T) organization is driving our digital strategy and evolution by transforming our capabilities, structures and processes to meet the needs of patients, our people, and the planet.
Zurich is one of Takeda-s key global hubs and an important location for our DD&T organization. We invite you to join our digital transformation journey, where you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and become part of an innovative organization contributing to global impact and improvement.
Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and the abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our colleagues- journey at Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team.

This is a dual-mandate role within Takeda-s Data, Digital & Technology (DD&T) organization, based in Zurich, Switzerland. Reporting into the Enterprise Process Platforms organization, the successful candidate will serve in two complementary capacities:
* **Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms -** providing dedicated, high-quality executive administrative support to the leader of the organization, with full administrative accountability for that leader.
* **DD&T Site Lead for Zurich -** serving as the local DD&T Leadership Team (LT) site support resource when DD&T LT members travel to Zurich, ensuring a consistent, professional, and executive-ready onsite experience.
The Zurich Site Lead responsibility focuses on site-specific logistics and local coordination for DD&T LT activity in Zurich; it does not include assuming administrative ownership for other LT members. This role is based in Zurich.

Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms
Provide dedicated executive administrative support to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms, operating with the discretion, judgment, and executive presence required to support a senior DD&T leader and to interact effectively with Takeda Executive Team (TET) members.
* **Calendar and schedule management:** Proactively own and manage a complex, frequently changing executive calendar - prioritizing commitments, resolving conflicts, and protecting time against competing demands.
* **Meeting coordination and agenda preparation:** Coordinate meetings end-to-end, prepare and circulate agendas, coordinate pre-reads, and ensure the leader is fully prepared.
* **Meeting facilitation:** Where appropriate, facilitate or lead meetings on behalf of the leader.
* **Executive communications:** Draft, review, and coordinate executive-level communications, and communicate clearly and professionally with TET members, senior leaders, and their assistants on behalf of the leader.
* **Stakeholder management:** Build and maintain strong working relationships across DD&T, the broader enterprise, and external partners, acting as a trusted point of contact for the leader-s office.
* **Travel and event logistics:** Organize complex domestic and international travel and associated logistics - including multi-party alignment across internal groups and, at times, external or industry partners - and partner with central meeting planning teams on larger trips, meetings, and events.
* **Expenses coordination:** Work with DD&T central expense management role to ensure appropriate submission and completion of leader expenses
* **Documents, presentations, and data:** Where appropriate, prepare and coordinate documents, correspondence, reports, and presentations; collect, review, enter, and format accurate data using Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; and ensure materials adhere to corporate and organizational standards.
* **Vendor and payment support:** Prepare documentation for payment of vendors, consultants, and suppliers; submit and track payment requests and purchase orders and respond to related inquiries.
* **Confidentiality, judgment and discretion:** Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion at all times and exercise strong, independent judgment - including the confidence to respectfully challenge or decline a request from a senior leader or TET member when it is in the best interest of the leader-s priorities.
* **Proactivity and problem solving:** Anticipate the leader-s needs, identify issues early, and resolve problems proactively before they escalate.
* **Continuous improvement and network:** Participate in process improvement and build a strong internal network to answer questions, solve problems, and execute responsibilities effectively.
* **Junior and team administrative support:** Provide guidance and support to junior administrative staff, enhancing team capabilities, and aid the broader administrative team as needed to ensure seamless DD&T senior leader support

s.h: * Perform other related duties as required.
s.t:
DD&T Zurich Site Lead (Local Hub Support)
Serve as the local DD&T site support resource and point of contact when DD&T Leadership Team (LT) members travel to Zurich. This responsibility is focused on site-specific logistics and local coordination - creating a consistent, high-quality experience for visiting DD&T LT members.
A. Site Logistics and Meeting Room Coordination
* Identify and book appropriate rooms for DD&T LT meetings based on attendee size, confidentiality, meeting type, executive experience, and technology requirements.
* Confirm room suitability - seating capacity, executive readiness, configuration, hybrid meeting capability, and proximity to relevant office areas.
* Coordinate with local workplace, facilities, reception, security, ETSS, CTSS, and AV teams as needed.
* Support onsite readiness before meetings begin - room access, setup, supplies, and escalation of facilities or technology issues.
* Serve as the local point of contact for site-specific logistical questions related to DD&T LT visits.
B. Catering and Hospitality Support
* Arrange catering for DD&T LT meetings, including working lunches, refreshments, and coffee service.
* Confirm dietary requirements, timing, delivery location, setup, and cleanup expectations.
* Coordinate with approved onsite catering providers and local site teams.
* Ensure catering plans align with the agenda, meeting flow, and executive-level expectations.
* Escalate issues promptly when catering, hospitality, or room readiness may impact the attendee experience.
C. Local Reservations and Offsite Needs
* Make restaurant reservations for DD&T LT dinners, small executive gatherings, and business meals connected to DD&T LT travel.
* Recommend appropriate local venues based on audience, purpose, location, accessibility, timing, and executive expectations.
* Coordinate reservation details, timing, attendee count, and dietary considerations with venues.
* Support approved offsite reservations connected to DD&T LT activities, keeping the primary scope on onsite hub support.

Rockstar is hiring a full-time Billing & Compliance Support Virtual Assistant on behalf of a pediatric therapy practice offering PT, OT, and SLP services.

The practice is growing, both in patient volume and provider headcount, and is working to build out more consistent systems and processes to support that growth without burning out its admin team.

Vous vous sentez à l-aise dans le domaine de la construction et souhaitez occuper un poste où vous pouvez avoir un impact à la fois au bureau et sur le chantier ? Alors cette mission pourrait bien vous convenir.
Nous sommes un département de terrassement familial et bien rodé au sein d-une PME suisse typique : terre-à-terre, directe et orientée solutions. Chez nous, les personnes qui réfléchissent, prennent des responsabilités et aiment collaborer avec les autres comptent - aussi bien au bureau que sur le chantier.
Nous recherchons une personne engagée, à l-aise avec l-informatique, qui prend plaisir à soutenir nos projets de terrassement sur le plan organisationnel, technique et administratif. Vous avez un intérêt pour les outils modernes, y compris ceux assistés par l-IA, et souhaitez les utiliser à l-avenir pour simplifier et rendre les processus plus efficaces. En même temps, vous êtes le lien important entre la direction et nos collaborateurs sur les chantiers.
**Vos tâches**
Dans cette fonction polyvalente, vous soutenez la direction dans l-organisation et la gestion de nos chantiers de terrassement. Vous travaillez de manière structurée au bureau, mais vous êtes également régulièrement sur les chantiers pour clarifier directement les questions avec nos collaborateurs.

* Soutien à la planification, coordination et supervision des projets de terrassement
* Visites régulières sur les chantiers pour clarifier questions, préoccupations et processus
* Liaison centrale entre la direction et les collaborateurs sur les chantiers
* Soutien dans la gestion des offres et des achats, y compris appels d-offres, avenants ainsi que les offres des fournisseurs et sous-traitants
* Traitement de l-administration des chantiers, y compris données de projet, rapports, bons de transport, métrés et travaux en régie
* Aide à la facturation, contrôle des factures et recalculs des projets terminés
* Gestion de la documentation des projets, plans, procès-verbaux et documents de chantier
* Contrôle de l-avancement des travaux, qualité, délais et sécurité au travail
* Aide à l-amélioration continue de nos processus et de la communication entre bureau et chantier
**Votre profil**
Nous ne cherchons pas une personne purement de bureau ni un chef de chantier classique. Nous cherchons quelqu-un qui aime faire les deux : des tâches administratives et techniques au bureau ainsi que le contact direct avec nos collaborateurs sur le chantier.

s.h: Vous correspondez bien à notre profil si vous
s.t:
* Disposez d-une formation achevée ou d-une expérience dans le secteur principal du bâtiment, travaux publics, terrassement, jardinage, construction de routes ou un domaine connexe
* Idéalement, avez une expérience dans une fonction comparable - ce n-est toutefois pas obligatoire ; ce qui compte, c-est votre intérêt, votre volonté d-apprendre et votre sens des processus de construction
* Comprenez les processus de construction et avez un bon sens de l-organisation
* Aimez communiquer avec les gens et résoudre les problèmes de manière orientée solutions
* Travaillez de manière autonome, fiable et structurée
* Êtes terre-à-terre, résistant et orienté travail d-équipe
* Vous sentez à l-aise au bureau et maîtrisez l-ordinateur, MS Office et les outils numériques
* Possédez un permis de conduire catégorie B
* Avez une bonne maîtrise de l-allemand à l-oral et à l-écrit
**Notre offre**
Vous prenez en charge chez nous une mission polyvalente dans un environnement pratique, avec des voies de décision courtes, un échange direct et la possibilité d-agir activement.

* Une fonction polyvalente entre bureau, chantier et direction
* Des voies de décision courtes et une hiérarchie plate dans une PME suisse typique
* Une culture du tutoiement ouverte et directe avec un échange simple
* Une équipe de terrassement bien rodée et terre-à-terre
* Beaucoup d-autonomie et de marge de manœuvre
* Des moyens de travail modernes
* Des conditions d-emploi équitables
* Des possibilités de développement selon vos compétences, intérêts et ambitions personnelles
* Vous trouverez d-autres avantages et informations sur notre portail carrière : www.jobs.agir.biz
**Pourquoi ce poste est intéressant**
Cette fonction convient particulièrement à quelqu-un qui connaît le bâtiment et souhaite assumer plus de responsabilités - sans perdre le contact direct avec le chantier. Vous êtes proche des collaborateurs, proche des projets et en même temps étroitement impliqué dans l-organisation et les voies de décision.
Chez nous, vous pouvez apporter votre expérience pratique, évoluer et contribuer à la réalisation fiable et soignée de nos projets de terrassement.

About the Client
We’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in the Bahamas find an Executive Assistant & Business Operations Specialist to work closely with its Founder & Principal.
The firm supports entrepreneurs, established businesses, institutions, and international clients across a diverse range of professional services, including strategic and financial advisory, corporate services, bookkeeping and accounting, HR and back-office administration, and project management.
This is an opportunity to work directly alongside an experienced business leader and become a trusted right hand across executive support, business operations, financial administration, research, and special projects.

We’re looking for a highly capable, analytical, and proactive Executive Assistant & Business Operations Specialist who can operate as a genuine extension of the Principal.
This is not a traditional task-based VA role , nor are we looking for a finance specialist. Instead, we need a commercially minded Executive Assistant who is comfortable working across different areas of a business, can quickly understand new concepts, and has the judgment to determine what needs to happen without always waiting for detailed instructions.
You’ll move between executive support, stakeholder communication, light financial administration, research, and operational projects. Strong proficiency with AI tools is also essential—you should know how to use AI intelligently to research, analyze, draft, organize, and improve the way work gets done.
Role Details
Commitment: Part-Time (25 hours/week initially, with potential to increase)
Working Hours: Aligned with Nassau / Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM), with the exact part-time schedule to be agreed
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Start Date: ASAP
Rate: $8-12/hour (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

Executive & Stakeholder Support
Work closely with the Principal on day-to-day executive and business priorities.
Manage stakeholder correspondence and ensure important communications receive timely follow-up.
Support calendar management, scheduling, meetings, and coordination.
Draft, review, organize, and respond to professional emails, documents, reports, and other communications.
Track commitments, requests, and action items to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
Attend virtual client and prospect meetings alongside the Principal and prepare accurate meeting notes, conclusions, and action items for timely distribution.
Support both business and occasional personal executive requirements where needed.
Handle sensitive business, financial, and personal information with a high degree of discretion.
Finance & Administrative Support
Work with QuickBooks and support day-to-day financial administration.
Assist with basic accounts receivable and payable, reconciliations, payroll administration, and financial documentation.
Help organize information and documentation required for VAT and other financial processes.
Maintain accurate records and proactively follow up on outstanding financial or administrative matters.
Coordinate with relevant finance or accounting professionals where required.
You do not need to be an accountant or financial analyst. We're looking for someone with a good understanding of finance and bookkeeping fundamentals who is comfortable navigating accounting software and can quickly learn the company's processes. Additional training will be provided where necessary.
Research & Business Operations
Conduct business, market, client, industry, and other research as required.
Analyze information and turn it into clear summaries, reports, and actionable recommendations.
Support operational and strategic projects across different areas of the business.
Coordinate projects, internal processes, deadlines, and follow-ups across stakeholders.
Take ownership of assigned projects from start to finish.
Identify inefficiencies and recommend practical ways to improve processes and reduce administrative workload.
AI & Workflow Efficiency
Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms extensively for research, analysis, drafting, summarization, and organization.
Use AI to accelerate work while applying strong judgment to verify, refine, and improve outputs.
Identify opportunities to incorporate AI and simple automation into everyday workflows.
Help the Principal and wider business operate more efficiently by finding smarter ways to organize and execute recurring work.

Must-Haves
Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Business Assistant, Operations Assistant, Business Operations Specialist, or in a similarly broad support role.
Experience supporting a founder, executive, business owner, or senior leader.
Excellent written and spoken English, including strong professional and business writing skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Experience using QuickBooks or similar accounting software and a good understanding of basic financial administration.
Familiarity with areas such as AR/AP, reconciliations, payroll administration, and financial documentation.
Strong proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT and/or Claude and the ability to use them for meaningful business work.
Strong research skills with the ability to synthesize information and communicate key findings clearly.
Excellent organization and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and projects simultaneously.
Strong judgment and the confidence to determine priorities and next steps independently.
High level of discretion when handling confidential information.
Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision.
Nice-to-Haves
Previous experience within professional services, consulting, financial services, banking, accounting, corporate services, real estate, or another commercially focused environment.
Experience supporting bookkeeping, VAT documentation, or similar finance administration.
Experience using Google Workspace, Microsoft Outlook, Google Drive, and similar business productivity tools.
Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement or basic workflow automation.
Experience working directly with clients, prospects, or senior external stakeholders.
Ideal Candidate Profile
This role is ideal for someone who is more than an administrator .
You're intellectually curious, commercially aware, and able to quickly understand how a business works. If you're given an objective rather than a detailed set of instructions, you're comfortable figuring out the steps required and moving things forward.
You can confidently switch between drafting an important client email, researching a business opportunity, updating QuickBooks, preparing meeting notes, following up on an outstanding payment, and using AI to turn a large amount of information into a concise executive summary.
Most importantly, you're proactive. You notice what needs attention, follow through reliably, and take genuine ownership of helping the Principal and the wider business operate effectively.

About SafeLease
At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both.

We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.

Assistenz CEO 50\-60% (m/w/d)
Die Häny AG ist ein traditionsreiches Industrieunternehmen mit Sitz in Jona. Wir entwickeln unsere Organisation konsequent weiter, stärken unsere Führungsstrukturen und treiben wichtige Transformations\- und Zukunftsthemen voran.
Zur direkten Unterstützung unseres CEO suchen wir eine erfahrene, diskrete und sehr strukturierte Persönlichkeit als **Assistenz CEO 50\-60% (m/w/d).**
In dieser vertrauensvollen Funktion arbeiten Sie eng mit dem CEO zusammen und unterstützen ihn bei der Vorbereitung, Koordination und Nachverfolgung von Geschäftsleitungs\-, Verwaltungsrats\-, Projekt\- und Organisationsthemen.
Sie sorgen dafür, dass Informationen strukturiert vorliegen, Entscheide sauber dokumentiert, offene Punkte konsequent weiterverfolgt und wichtige Themen zum richtigen Zeitpunkt wieder aufgenommen werden.
Assistenz CEO 50\-60% (m/w/d)
=============================
**Ihre Aufgaben**
* Vorbereitung, Koordination und Nachbereitung von Geschäftsleitungssitzungen und Verwaltungsratsunterlagen
* Strukturierung und Zusammenstellung von Traktanden, Sitzungsunterlagen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen
* Führung und konsequente Nachverfolgung von Pendenzen, Massnahmen und Verantwortlichkeiten
* Koordination von Fristen, Rückmeldungen, Versionen und offenen Punkten
* Unterstützung des CEO bei der Vorbereitung von Führungsgesprächen, Workshops und wichtigen internen Terminen
* Erstellung und Aufbereitung von Präsentationen, Übersichten, Entscheidungsnotizen und internen Kommunikationsunterlagen
* Administrative und organisatorische Unterstützung bei ausgewählten Transformations\-, Organisations\- und Sonderprojekten
* Pflege einer strukturierten Ablage für CEO\-, GL\-, VR\- und Projektdokumente
* Weiterentwicklung von Vorlagen, Übersichten und einfachen Steuerungsinstrumenten für den Führungsalltag
* Koordination von Terminen, Abstimmungen und Follow\-ups im direkten Umfeld des CEO
**Ihr Profil**
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als CEO\-/GL\-Assistenz, Executive Assistant, Projektassistenz oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit Nähe zu Geschäftsleitung oder Unternehmensführung
* Ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit und sehr strukturierte, selbständige Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Diskretion, Integrität und Vertrauenswürdigkeit
* Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte rasch zu erfassen, zu strukturieren und auf das Wesentliche zu reduzieren
* Freude daran, Themen konsequent nachzuverfolgen und Verbindlichkeit professionell einzufordern
* Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit in Deutsch
* Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365, insbesondere Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint, Word und Excel
* Ruhiges, souveränes und professionelles Auftreten
* Vorausschauende, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
**Was Sie auszeichnet**
Sie denken mit, behalten auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick und erkennen, was als Nächstes ötigt wird.
Sie verstehen Ihre Rolle nicht als reine administrative Unterstützung, sondern als strukturierende Kraft im Hintergrund. Sie tragen dazu bei, dass Führungsprozesse strukturiert vorbereitet, Entscheide sauber dokumentiert und vereinbarte Massnahmen konsequent nachverfolgt werden.
Dabei arbeiten Sie diskret, verbindlich und mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch.

* Eine vertrauensvolle Funktion in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit dem CEO
* Ein vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet mit Einblick in Unternehmensführung, Organisation und Transformation
* Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein unternehmerisch geprägtes Umfeld
* Die Möglichkeit, Führungs\- und Arbeitsstrukturen aktiv mitzugestalten

* Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz am Hauptsitz der Häny AG in Jona

This is a remote position.
What We Do
At Outsource Access , we help a thriving family-run home services group in Charleston, South Carolina scale their brand visibility across plumbing, trenchless pipelining, and residential handyman/remodeling services. We don't just edit videos and schedule social media posts—we make sure our clients build undeniable market authority, engage their local community, and drive inbound lead growth through high-quality, strategic storytelling.
How You’ll Make a Difference
Stopping the Scroll: You will turn raw photos and video footage into high-performing, scroll-stopping content—including shorts, reels, and standard posts—across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Google Business Profile (GBP) for three distinct brands.
Owning the Brand Narrative: You will take creative control by independently building and managing the content calendar while designing engaging social graphics, flyers, and promotional assets using Canva or Adobe that strictly adhere to existing brand guidelines.
Building Local Authority: You will actively foster community trust by handling comments and DMs, identifying and posting in relevant local Facebook groups, and supporting basic SEO and backlink health tied to GBP to generate organic inbound leads.
Driving Real-World Connections: You will research and coordinate local trade show and networking opportunities (such as Alignable, BNI, and Chamber of Commerce events) by handling outreach, event registrations, scheduling, and sponsorship correspondence.

Is This You?
The Creative Strategist: You have proven hands-on experience in social media management, graphic design, and video editing (backed by a strong portfolio of work samples), and you aren't afraid to bring fresh ideas, professional judgment, and constructive opinions to the table.
The Autonomous Owner: You thrive in a low-oversight environment and are excited to transition from close approval-based work during onboarding to independently owning the marketing strategy as a genuine thought partner—with the ambition to grow into a future marketing supervisor role.
The Brand Chameleon: You are detail-oriented and comfortable managing three distinct companies under one ownership group simultaneously, effortlessly adapting your content style to represent the unique tone and credibility of the home services and trades industry.
Tech-Savvy: You have a solid working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Google Workspace, and Google Business Profile management, and you are comfortable communicating directly with the business owner primarily via WhatsApp.
Your Home Office: You have a reliable personal computer capable of handling professional-grade design and video editing workloads in a BYOD setup, paired with a stable, high-speed internet connection and a quiet work-from-home environment aligned with Eastern Time business hours.

s.h: Why You’ll Love Being Part of the OAmazing Team
s.t:
You’re not just taking a job — you’re stepping into a role where your growth, security, and peace of mind actually matter. Here is the total package we’ve built for you:
Your Wellness & Security
Health & Wellness — Covered: You get comprehensive HMO coverage with a top provider so you can focus on work without worrying about medical bills.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS (TQs): Your resume must clearly demonstrate that you possess the following technical qualifications.

TQ 1: Demonstrates executive experience in providing leadership and direction to a complex scientific or technical organization, such as the management or oversight of nationally recognized large-scale research and development facilities or programs.

TQ 2: Demonstrates a general understanding of science and technology, as well as a working knowledge of and ability to oversee a wide variety of business and operational management systems.

EXECUTIVE CORE QUALIFICATIONS (ECQs): In addition to the Technical Qualification Requirements listed above, all new entrants into the Senior Executive Service (SES) under a career appointment will be assessed for executive competency against the following five mandatory ECQs.

If your 2-page resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of the ECQs and TQs, you may not receive further consideration for the position.

There are five ECQs: ECQ 1: Commitment to the Rule of Law and the Principles of the American Founding - This core qualification requires a demonstrated knowledge of the American system of government, commitment to uphold the Constitution and the rule of law, and commitment to serve the American people.

ECQ 2: Driving Efficiency - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to strategically and efficiently manage resources, budget effectively, cut wasteful spending, and pursue efficiency through process and technological upgrades.

ECQ 3: Merit and Competence - This core qualification involves the demonstrated knowledge, ability and technical competence to effectively and reliably produce work that is of exceptional quality.

ECQ 4: Leading People - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a group toward meeting the organization's vision, mission, and goals, and to drive a high-performance, high-accountability culture. This includes, when necessary, the ability to lead people through change and to hold individuals accountable.

ECQ 5: Achieving Results - This core qualification involves the demonstrated ability to achieve both individual and organizational results, and to align results to stated goals from superiors.

Note: If you are a member of the SES or have been certified through successful participation in an OPM approved SES Candidate Development Program (SESCDP), or have SES reinstatement eligibility, you do not need to respond to the ECQs.

Instead, you should attach proof (e.g., SF-50, Certification by OPM's SES Qualifications Review Board (QRB)) of your eligibility for noncompetitive appointment to the SES.
